welcome.title: Welcome to Sublarr
welcome.subtitle: Let's set up your subtitle manager in a few quick steps.

mode_step.description: Choose how you want to use Sublarr.
mode_step.arr_description: Use with Sonarr and/or Radarr for automatic media detection
mode_step.standalone_description: Point at media folders directly, no Sonarr/Radarr needed

arr_step.description: Connect your *arr instances to detect missing subtitles.

standalone_step.description: Point Sublarr at your media folders directly.
standalone_step.media_folders_help: Add folders containing your media files. Sublarr will scan them for series and movies.

pathmapping_step.description: Map remote paths to local paths (if *arr runs on a different host).
pathmapping_step.label: Path Mapping
pathmapping_step.help: Format: remote_prefix=local_prefix (semicolon-separated for multiple). Leave empty if Sublarr runs on the same host as Sonarr/Radarr.

providers_step.description: Configure subtitle provider API keys for searching.
providers_step.info: AnimeTosho works without an API key. Add others for broader coverage.

language_step.help: Subtitles are searched in the target language. Source language is used when Sublarr needs to translate or transcribe.

automation_step.auto_search_description: Sublarr periodically scans the library and searches providers for missing subtitles in your target language.
automation_step.upgrade_label: Upgrade existing subtitles when better matches are found
automation_step.upgrade_description: Re-runs scoring on existing subtitles and replaces them when a higher-scoring candidate is available.
automation_step.settings_hint: All of these can be changed later in Settings → Automation.

ollama_step.description: Set up the LLM translation backend.

mediaservers_step.description: Configure media servers for automatic library refresh after subtitle downloads.
mediaservers_step.info: Add media servers for automatic library refresh after subtitle downloads. You can skip this and configure later in Settings.

scan_step.description: Run your first wanted scan to find missing subtitles.
scan_step.info: Run a scan to find episodes and movies missing subtitles.
scan_step.scan_started: Scan started! Check the Wanted page for results.

errors.complete_failed: Could not finalise onboarding — try again or visit Settings.

setup.title: Welcome to Sublarr
setup.subtitle: Set a password to protect the UI, or leave it open.

library_step.description: What does your library mainly contain?
library_step.question: What do you mainly want to manage? Sublarr picks matching scoring defaults for you.
library_step.anime_description: ASS-first scoring, fansub-group aware — the classic Sublarr setup.
library_step.movies_description: Hash and title/year matches weighted for film libraries.
library_step.mixed_description: Series and movies together — keeps the balanced defaults.
library_step.help: This only sets sensible scoring defaults. Everything stays adjustable later under Settings → Scoring.
library_step.preset_failed: Could not apply the scoring preset — defaults stay active

performance_step.description: How much load may Sublarr put on this machine?
performance_step.light_description: Gentle scan intervals and low parallelism — for NAS boxes and small servers.
performance_step.balanced_description: Sensible middle ground for most setups.
performance_step.aggressive_description: Frequent scans and high parallelism — for powerful hardware.
performance_step.apply_failed: Could not apply the performance profile
